overview: The Medford School Committee met to review math pathways, school operational reports, and proposed heat protocols, while approving a Model UN field trip, MSBA data collection, and a substitute teacher report.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, including bills, payrolls, and past meeting minutes.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent presented district updates, recognizing MAFLA's new president, driver crash prevention training, upcoming kindergarten registration, and an ongoing DESE monitoring review.

items.title: Model UN Dartmouth Trip Request
items.summary: The committee approved an out-of-state field trip for the Model United Nations club to attend a conference at Dartmouth College in Hanover, New Hampshire.

items.title: Math Placement and Integrated Math Pathways Update
items.summary: Mathematics Director Faiza Khan presented plans to shift middle school math acceleration placement to seventh grade and update high school integrated math course flows.

items.title: Curtis-Tufts High School Update
items.summary: Principal Laurie Hodgdon presented an operational and academic update on Curtis-Tufts High School, highlighting therapeutic services, service-learning grants, and attendance goals.

items.title: Brooks Elementary School Update
items.summary: Principal Shannon Demos and Assistant Principal Sheila Burke presented an overview of Brooks Elementary School's demographics, literacy programs, school culture, and facility needs.

items.title: Proposed Excessive Heat Protocols
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Dr. Peter Cushing introduced draft district protocols and equipment considerations for extreme heat conditions, with committee members requesting revisions and cost estimates by March.

items.title: MSBA Eligibility Phase Data Collection Resolution
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution requesting the superintendent's team to collect data required for the MSBA eligibility process by March 31, 2024.

items.title: Annual Agenda Resolution
items.summary: A resolution regarding establishing an annual school committee agenda was withdrawn following discussion of an upcoming Committee of the Whole meeting.

items.title: Substitute Teacher Shortage Report Resolution
items.summary: The committee approved an amended motion requesting a comprehensive report on substitute teacher needs, compensation, and coverage impacts due by April 8, 2024.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of several former district staff, family members, and community members.
